SELECT
FROM ESS_APPLY_OT OT, HR_EMPLOYEE HR WHERE OT.PERSON_ID = HR.PERSON_ID(+) AND OT.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND (OT.PERSON_ID NOT LIKE '111111%' OR (OT.PERSON_ID IS NULL AND OT.CREATED_BY = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND OT.ACTIVITY = '1' AND OT.BATCH_YN <> 2
AND (EXISTS (SELECT B1.DEPTID FROM HR_DEPARTMENT B1 WHERE B1.DEPTNO = HR.DEPTNO START WITH B1.DEPTNO IN (SELECT HRD.DEPTID FROM HR_DEPARTMENT HRD WHERE HRD.MANAGER_EMP_ID = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) CONNECT BY PRIOR B1.DEPTNO = B1.PARENT_DEPT_NO UNION SELECT AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.DEPTNO FROM AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO WHERE AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.DEPTNO = HR.DEPTNO AND AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.PERSON_ID = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) OR OT.PERSON_ID IS NULL)
AND INSTR(',' || #{deptNos, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ',', ',' || HR.DEPTNO || ',') > 0
AND (HR.EMPID LIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(HR.LOCAL_NAME)) LIKE '%' || CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(#{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) || '%' OR UPPER(HR.ENGLISH_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) || '%')
AND TO_CHAR(OT.OT_TYPE_CODE) = #{searchOtTypeCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND GET_AR_SHIFTNO(HR.PERSON_ID, TO_CHAR(OT.APPLY_OT_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) = #{shiftNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND TO_CHAR(OT.AFFIRM_FLAG) = #{searchAffirmFlag, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND NVL(TO_CHAR(OT.AFFIRM_FLAG), ' ') <> '14014310'
AND OT.APPLY_OT_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
AND OT.APPLY_OT_DATE < TO_DATE(#{endDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY') + 1
ORDER BY OT.APPLY_TIME DESC NULLS FIRST, OT.APPLY_NO DESC

SELECT
FROM ESS_APPLY_OT OT, HR_EMPLOYEE HR WHERE OT.PERSON_ID = HR.PERSON_ID(+) AND OT.APPLY_NO = #{applyNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ESS_APPLY_OT ( APPLY_NO, APPLY_OT_DATE, OT_FROM_TIME, OT_TO_TIME, OT_APPLY_HOUR, OT_TYPE_NO, OT_TYPE_CODE, CONFIRM_FLAG, ADJUST_YN, SPECIAL_YN, OFFSET_YN, DEDUCT_YN, ACTIVITY, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_IP, CPNY_ID, BATCH_YN, SEND_EMAIL_FLAG ) VALUES ( #{applyNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRUNC(SYSDATE), TO_DATE('00:00', 'HH24:MI'), TO_DATE('00:00', 'HH24:MI'), '0', '31', (SELECT P.OT_TYPE_CODE FROM ESS_APPLY_OT_PARAM P WHERE P.TYPE_ID = GET_AR_DATETYPE(#{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND P.ADJUST_YN = 0 AND P.SPECIAL_YN = 0 AND P.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ROWNUM = 1), 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, SYSDATE, #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{adminIP, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '1', 0 )
mapper.select: WITH P AS ( SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{applyOtDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS D_DOT, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{applyOtDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS D_SLASH FROM DUAL ), T AS ( SELECT P.D_DOT, P.D_SLASH, GET_OT_TYPE_CODE(#{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, P.D_DOT, 0, 0) AS OT_TYPE_CODE FROM P ) SELECT T.OT_TYPE_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(T.OT_TYPE_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS OT_TYPE_CODE_NAME, GET_OT_LENGTH_SPC(#{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, T.D_DOT, T.OT_TYPE_CODE, #{otFromTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{otToTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deductYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS OT_LENGTH, GET_AR_DATETYPE(#{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, T.D_SLASH, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS DATETYPE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(GET_AR_SHIFT_START_TIME(#{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, T.D_SLASH, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), 'HH24:MI') AS SHIFT_START_TIME, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(GET_AR_SHIFT_END_TIME(#{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, T.D_SLASH, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), 'HH24:MI') AS SHIFT_END_TIME, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(GET_AR_SHIFT_END_TIME(#{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, T.D_SLASH, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') + 1/12, 'HH24:MI') AS SHIFT_END_TIME_2, GET_AR_TIME_BY_CPNYID(#{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, T.D_SLASH, 'IN', #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS INDOOR_TIME, GET_AR_TIME_BY_CPNYID(#{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, T.D_SLASH, 'OUT', #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS OUTDOOR_TIME, GET_OT_LENGTH_SPC(#{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, T.D_DOT, T.OT_TYPE_CODE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(GET_AR_SHIFT_START_TIME(#{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, T.D_SLASH, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), 'HH24:MI'), TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(GET_AR_SHIFT_END_TIME(#{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, T.D_SLASH, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), 'HH24:MI'), #{deductYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS OT_SHIFT_LENGTH FROM T

SELECT GET_GLOBAL_NAME(GET_AR_SHIFTNO(HR.PERSON_ID, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{applyOtDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYY/MM/DD'), #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS SHIFT_NAME, TO_CHAR(HR.POST_FAMILY) AS POST_FAMILY, TO_CHAR(HR.DUTY_NO) AS DUTY_NO, TO_CHAR(HR.OT_LIMIT) AS OT_LIMIT, GET_AR_OT_TOTAIL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{applyOtDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYY/MM/DD'), #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, HR.PERSON_ID, '141444') AS WEEKDAY_OT_TOTAIL, GET_AR_OT_TOTAIL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{applyOtDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYY/MM/DD'), #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, HR.PERSON_ID, '141445') AS WEEKEND_OT_TOTAIL, GET_AR_OT_TOTAIL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{applyOtDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYY/MM/DD'), #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, HR.PERSON_ID, '141446') AS HOILDAY_OT_TOTAIL, GET_AR_OT_TOTAIL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{applyOtDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYY/MM/DD'), #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, HR.PERSON_ID, '200') AS OT_TOTAIL, GET_AR_OT_TOTAIL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{applyOtDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYY/MM/DD'), #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, HR.PERSON_ID, '30') AS OT_TOTAIL_MONTH FROM HR_EMPLOYEE HR WHERE HR.PERSON_ID = #{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT GET_AR_DATETYPE(#{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, D.D_DASH, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS DATETYPE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(GET_AR_SHIFT_START_TIME(#{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, D.D_DASH, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI'), 'HH24:MI') AS SHIFT_START_TIME, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(GET_AR_SHIFT_END_TIME(#{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, D.D_DASH, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI'), 'HH24:MI') AS SHIFT_END_TIME, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(GET_AR_SHIFT_END_TIME(#{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, D.D_DASH, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') + 2/24, 'HH24:MI') AS SHIFT_END_TIME_2 FROM (SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{applyOtDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS D_DASH FROM DUAL) D

SELECT AR_GET_OT_CLASH( #{applyNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{applyOtDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || #{otFromTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{applyOtDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || #{otToTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{offsetYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) FROM DUAL
mapper.update: UPDATE ESS_APPLY_OT SET PERSON_ID = #{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, APPLY_TIME = SYSDATE, OFFSET_YN = #{offsetYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DEDUCT_YN = #{deductYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, OT_APPLY_HOUR = #{otApplyHour, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, OT_TYPE_CODE = #{otTypeCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, OT_FROM_TIME = TO_DATE(#{applyOtDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ' ' || #{otFromTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI'), OT_TO_TIME = TO_DATE(#{applyOtDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ' ' || #{otToTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI'), APPLY_OT_REMARK = #{applyOtRemark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, AFFIRM_FLAG = 14014306, APPLY_OT_DATE = TO_DATE(#{applyOtDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), UPDATED_BY = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_IP = #{adminIP, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE, CONFIRM_FLAG = 0, CONFIRM_DATE = NULL, CONFIRM_BY = NULL, CONFIRM_IP = NULL, ACTIVITY = 1, BATCH_NO = 0, CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SEND_EMAIL_FLAG = 0, MISDOCID = #{misDocId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE APPLY_NO = #{applyNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
